messages:
Maria Chen: Ok team — Lighthouse kickoff thread. Customer goes live in 8 weeks. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 onboarding plan. Who can own the playbook and training?
Tom Alvarez: I can own the playbook + enablement materials. Will need an SE to pair for the first two training sessions.
Jess Patel: I’ll take training scheduling and attendee lists. Can we confirm SSO + data ingestion owners?
Samir Khan: I’ll take SSO (Okta) + staging deployment verification. Tagging infra for network egress rules.
Maria Chen: Great. High-level success criteria proposed: 1) API integration with low error rate (<2% failed calls), 2) latency under 300ms P95 for 90% of demo flows, 3) exec sign-off on ML outputs quality for 3 major prompts. Anyone object?
Tom Alvarez: Sounds reasonable. Add: documentation acceptance (internal + developer guide) and one runbook for failover.
Jess Patel: +1 to runbook. Also request weekly health check cadence for first 30 days (Mon 11am PT).
Maria Chen: Ok set cadence weekly x4 then bi-weekly. Renewal risk flag: customer mentioned tight procurement timeline at month 3; we should capture usage milestones to feed renewal narrative.
Samir Khan: Noted. I’ll add instrumentation hooks and dashboard metrics (errors, tokens, latency, model fallbacks).
Jess Patel: For feedback capture — propose a short NPS-style survey at day 14 + qualitative interview at day 45. Also create a shared doc for prompt/test cases.
Tom Alvarez: Assigning owners (quick): Playbook = Tom; Training schedule = Jess; SSO + staging = Samir; Runbook = Tom + Samir; Instrumentation = Samir; Exec check = Maria.
Maria Chen: Nice. Drafting timeline (rough):
```
Week 0: Kickoff, SSO test, staging access
Week 1-2: Integration QA, two training sessions, playbook v1
Week 3-4: Performance tuning, runbook v1, health dashboard live
Week 5-8: Production cutover window, exec QA, survey at day14, qualitative at day45
```
Maria Chen: Risks: SSO cert rotation schedule unknown (ask customer), potential schema mismatch on event payloads, and delayed procurement. Callouts: need legal to sign DPA before prod.
Jess Patel: Action items I have: collect attendee emails, create calendar invites (will send today), add survey draft to shared doc.
Samir Khan: Action items I have: request Okta metadata, provision staging with test dataset, add Prometheus metrics for latency/errors.
Tom Alvarez: Action items I have: start playbook skeleton, collect top-10 prompts from customer for eval, prepare training slides.
Elena (deploy-bot): Deployment check: staging cluster created at 2026-03-20T17:22Z — workspace: lighthouse-staging.
Maria Chen: Thanks — next sync: kickoff meeting tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: quick intros, timeline confirm, ownership sign-off, initial technical blockers. If you can’t make it, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
